title: Chapter 1082
text:
"Doesn't belong to this era?"

Ames tilted her head with a strange expression. "Then, how did you know?"

Han Xiao paused and did not answer this question. He changed the topic and said in a low voice,

He changed the topic and whispered, "This is a secret organization that specializes in developing Esper Ability technology. At the same time, they're also a mysterious arms dealer. Their products occasionally appear on the black market, and now, they're eyeing the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy …"

There was a lot of information that was inconvenient to reveal to Ames, so Han Xiao did not tell her too much. He was only secretly surprised.

The first time this organization appeared publicly was during the World Tree War. As a member of the explored universe, they participated in the war to resist the invasion of the World Tree Civilization and used their Esper Ability technology in the war.

Now, it was only Version 4.0 of the Flickering World, several versions away from the World Tree War in the later storyline of his previous life. In Han Xiao's impression, this group of people should not have appeared in this era, which was why he was surprised.

The name of this organization was' Holy Covenant '. Even in the later versions of his previous life, they were extremely mysterious. He only knew that most of the members of this organization were descendants of different Beyond Grade As.

Other than these Esper Ability technology, there were also a large number of historical Beyond Grade As who participated in the World Tree War together with the Holy Covenant organization. They were all famous Beyond Grade As whose deaths were confirmed. They seemed to have revived and returned to this universe. Quite a number of them were famous Primordial Ones.

Such a powerful reinforcements with black technology and high-level combatants injected vitality into the chaotic battle back then, dealing a lot of damage to the high-level combatants of the World Tree Civilization.

The revival of these historical Beyond Grade As was very exciting, but the reason for their revival was a mystery to the players. The advanced civilizations had sealed off the information, so the players had no way of knowing the inside story. In his previous life, Han Xiao naturally had no way of knowing the truth.

However, although the first time the Holy Covenant organization appeared was during the World Tree War, that was not the case for the Primordial Ones. Early in the Calamity of the Supers version, another batch of Primordial Ones had awakened and became one of the fuses of the Calamity of the Supers.

Back then, the explanation that these Primordial Ones gave to the outside world was that they had pretended to die in battle during the exploration era and entered a special high-level life-sustaining cabin to hibernate, trying to avoid the tragic exploration era war. They did not want to die in vain and hoped to wake up in the future. With their great power, they could dominate the universe in the new era.

But something seemed to have gone wrong. The place where they slept was caught in the flames of war, and the life support cabins drifted through the universe before landing on a barren planet. At the same time, the life support cabins malfunctioned, and they were unable to wake up at the set time. They could only linger on in a deep sleep. Like this, countless years passed. Although the special life support cabins could slow down the decay of the body and soul, they were still gradually heading towards extinction.

Coincidentally, when they were on the brink of death, a scientific research team dug them out and reactivated the life-sustaining pods. Only then did they wake up from their deep slumber and spend a long time recovering to their peak state.

At that time, the outside world only knew that the revival of the Primordial Ones was a fact. Although there were loopholes in this statement, such as how a Beyond Grade A could be restricted by a small life capsule, the truth could not be verified. The public could only believe it and think that this was the truth.

Therefore, in summary, in the version of his previous life, the Primordial Ones had appeared twice. Once during the Calamity of the Supers, and the other time during the World Tree War. The two groups were different.

The group of Primordial Ones that appeared in the Calamity of the Supers version did not seem to be on the same side as the Holy Covenant Organization. However, whether or not they were really related, the players in his previous life had no way of knowing. Therefore, Han Xiao was not sure about the connection between the two.

If they were related, then the group of Primordial Ones that woke up during the Calamity of the Supers might have lied. They might not have returned through the life support cabins.

"The Holy Covenant Organization …"

Han Xiao pondered and guessed the other party's intentions.

This organization had existed for a long time, and they had clearly minded their own business. However, they had suddenly attacked him, which meant that the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was extremely important to the Holy Covenant Organization, to the point that they did not hesitate to offend an important person who stood at the peak of the universe … According to the nature of the Holy Covenant Organization, could it be that they wanted to develop some new technology based on the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy?

Then, the Holy Covenant Organization in his previous life should have done something similar … Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

If that was the case, the Holy Covenant Organization in his previous life might have secretly worked with EsGod. They split up the other Primal Esper Ability Entities and exchanged them for the resources in EsGod's hands. Then, they obtained the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy and split it in half with EsGod.

If that was the case, some of EsGod's Super High Risk Esper Abilities in the later stages might have been provided by the Holy Covenant Organization …

Originally, it was fine if he did not know, but now that Han Xiao realized that the Holy Covenant Organization had existed in this era, he could not help but become very interested in it.

"The Holy Covenant Organization ran away after one shot, thinking that they would not be exposed. Little did they know that I already knew about their origins."

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows, and his mood became better again.

Compared to this great discovery of the century, suffering a small loss in their hands was nothing.

At this time, Ames asked curiously, "Your dynasty's Clottey was swept away by the space turbulence. Will he be fine?"

"Don't worry, he's just lost. With his ability and the Universal Treasures in his hands, it won't take long for him to escape."

Han Xiao was not worried about the Dark Emperor at all. No matter where he fell, Clottey was the more dangerous existence at the top of the food chain to that creature from the secondary dimension.

However, he could not track Clottey in the space turbulence, so he could not get him out. The Holy Covenant Organization's fleet also used the Dimensional Exile Bullet to send themselves into the space turbulence to prevent them from being chased.

Because his Virtual Intrusion was interrupted by the Memory Formatting Virus, Han Xiao did not leave any hidden data in the other party's spaceship. This was like stabbing a needle into the spaceship without warning, only to discover that there was a needle hidden inside. Next time, he would be prepared. As long as he deliberately put on a thick layer of data shield as a buffer and got rid of the virus before it spread, it would be very difficult for this trap to work on him.

At this time, Han Xiao looked at the containment device of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy and realized that this guy was very agitated, crazily ramming into the inner wall of the container and screaming.

"Ahhhh, it hurts!"

Seeing this, Han Xiao could not help but mourn.

In his previous life, his body had been torn apart by someone. He thought that with EsGod taken care of, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy would not repeat the same mistake. He did not expect that his penis would still be taken away.

Furthermore, his treatment might be even worse. In his previous life, EsGod only used his ability and did not torture him. The Holy Covenant Organization would definitely conduct research on it, which meant that the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy would feel all kinds of 'torture' from that part of his body …

Han Xiao was even more sympathetic.

"Speaking of which, how did you feel just now? You couldn't control your body?"

"That's right. I don't know what they did, but they stimulated my core and made me lose control of my body. Then, they used an irresistible force field to drag me over."

Han Xiao rolled his eyes. "Then, can you still feel the location of that part of your body?"

"I can …" Before the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy finished, as if it was stimulated, its entire body suddenly shrank. It said in shock, "Ah! My senses are blocked! "

Han Xiao raised his brows, but he was not surprised.

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was an expert in the study of Primal Esper Ability Entities. There was no way it would leave such an obvious clue for others to follow.

However, did this not mean that this part of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy's body had been cut off, and all that was left was the illusion of pain?

"Hahahaha!" The Holy Light Particle laughed so hard that it was rolling on the ground. "Karma, to think that you would have such a day!"

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was like a cat that had just been neutered. It flipped through its missing body parts and said in grief and anger, "Black Star! Black Star! You have to help me get my body back! "

Han Xiao's lips twitched.

Why do I feel like I've taken away Evans' role?

But I don't want to participate in a big battle!

At this time, a notification popped up on the interface as usual.

You have triggered the mission [Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy's Request for Help]!

Mission Introduction: A mysterious organization has taken part of the core energy of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy from you. The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy hopes that you can help him get it back.

Mission Requirements: Get back the missing core energy of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy.

Reward: 1,500,000,000 Experience, 1 Random Reward, + 60 Favorability of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, + 1 Favorability of the Holy Light Particle, [Primal Esper Ability Entity Affinity]

[Primal Esper Ability Entity Affinity]: The Primal Esper Ability Entity will be more likely to accept you.

There's indeed a mission … Han Xiao looked at it and calculated in his mind.

The reward of this mission was rather ordinary, so he did not pay much attention to it. However, dealing with the Holy Covenant organization seemed to be an opportunity to complete [Primal Esper Ability Collector].

If he were to try his luck and find ownerless Primal Esper Abilities, he did not know when he would be able to gather four slots. Now that he had encountered the Holy Covenant organization that specialized in Esper Ability technology, they definitely had a lot of stock. If he could get it back, this milestone mission would be easily completed.

Han Xiaoxin made up his mind and replied, "Okay, I'll do it.

However, they're very elusive. It won't be that easy to find them. "

"As long as you're willing to help me." The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was overjoyed.

Black Star was not its host; he was only using it as a tool. It did not have the right to ask for his help. Even without a part of its body, it could still be useful. Therefore, it was really afraid that Han Xiao would not agree.

Han Xiao comforted it with a few words. He then took out the backup Mysterious Energy Host carrier and stuffed the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy into it again. He did not give it any time to recover from its psychological trauma and continued to make it work.

At this time, Ames looked at the raging space turbulence around them, frowned, and said, "The space turbulence released by that group of people has caused serious damage to the Land of Dead Silence. If we don't do anything about it, this secondary dimension might disappear before Hella comes again."

Hearing that, Han Xiao also looked around. The originally broken space wall of the Land of Dead Silence now looked like it had been eaten by worms, with more and more small holes appearing.

This dimension was related to Hella, so the two of them could not just leave it be. Han Xiao had no choice but to summon a large piece of space equipment to control the environment.

The thickness of the space wall depended on the core energy of the secondary dimension. Only when there was enough energy would the space wall self-repair. The area of the dimension continued to expand. Han Xiao could only try his best to lead the space turbulence released by the Dimensional Exile Bullet out of the Land of Dead Silence to reduce the pollution.

This was a difficult project. The two of them stayed in the Land of Dead Silence for quite a while before they managed to expel the space turbulence inside the dimension.

At this time, the two of them sensed something and realized that the resurrection tokens they were wearing suddenly had a drastic increase in temperature.

At the same time, a golden-orange Radiance suddenly appeared on a broken black floating island in the distance.

Han Xiao immediately turned around and was slightly stunned.

A golden-orange phantom emerged from the black desert. It looked like a spirit body, and the appearance of this phantom was that of a female humanoid creature. She looked gentle and beautiful, wearing beautiful clothes. She looked extremely young, but her eyes were very deep and vicissitudes of life. She had a kind temperament like a grandmother, and she was silently looking at the two of them.

Seeing this, the two of them were slightly shocked.

When they first arrived, they had already checked the entire secondary dimension. They clearly did not sense any existence, but now, a strange phantom had appeared out of nowhere. They did not know what it was, but it managed to avoid their senses.

After the attack of the Holy Accord organization, Han Xiao's vigilance had yet to subside. He was secretly preparing for battle.

At this time, the resurrection tokens on the two of them actually showed signs of floating. The phantom pointed at the two resurrection tokens and released a mental wave.

"Can you tell me, what is your relationship with the creator of these two coins?"

…

In the space turbulence, the Holy Covenant organization's fleet with its shield activated was floating up and down.

In the command room, Law held the containment device and observed the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy fragments. He was not very satisfied and sighed.

"Sigh, Black Star's recovery ability is too strong. The products the organization gave us have limited effects on him. We didn't have enough time, so we could only get a small part of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy."

"Be content. At least we met the minimum requirement and made up for the synthesis materials. We can report back now. If we were a little greedy and did not escape decisively, our spaceship might have been invaded and controlled by Black Star when he recovered, "Fay whispered.

Although they had achieved the minimum goal of this operation, the two of them knew how dangerous it was. They were still extremely wary of Han Xiao and almost got wiped out.

"The sneak attack this time was a success, but it also made him wary. The next time we meet him, we won't be able to achieve this result. Plus, he'll probably report the technology we have to the dynasty, which will bring some risk to the organization." Law was worried.

Fay was more optimistic. "Luckily, the mission is completed. Even if Black Star is wary, it doesn't matter. We won't have to deal with him again. There won't be a next time."

"That's true."

After chatting for a while, Law put away the containment device. He suddenly thought of something and said, "Oh, right.

"Right, I remember that the data on the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy shows that it and the Holy Light Particle are mortal enemies. Their energies have conflicting reactions. Maybe I can use this characteristic to develop a special detection device to find the Holy Light Particle."

Hearing this, Fay agreed.

"Hmm, you're right. The Holy Light Particle has been missing for many years, and we don't know where it is hidden. It's also an important synthesis material. The organization will probably take your suggestion seriously and make the Holy Light Particle their next target."
